summary: Created a 5-phase, source-grounded plan to restore exclusion and imposition from abb3bf7d^ and port them to the current API. Direct source inspection narrowed the port to the solver abstraction only (import z3 + z3.is_true/is_false -> z3_shim + model_checker.solver is_true/is_false); the modular models.* structure and syntactic/utils re-exports already exist at abb3bf7d^, materially de-risking the work. Sequential waves: exclusion establishes the recipe (Phases 1-2), imposition reuses it (Phases 3-4), consolidated verification (Phase 5).

artifacts.summary: 5-phase implementation plan for restoring and porting the exclusion and imposition theories to the current z3_shim/solver/models.* API.

decisions_made: Scoped the port to the solver abstraction only after confirming abb3bf7d^ already uses models.semantic/proposition/structure/constraints and current syntactic/utils re-exports.
Kept exclusion and imposition phases sequential because both register into the same theory_lib/__init__.py AVAILABLE_THEORIES and imposition reuses the exclusion-established recipe.
Flagged dead backup modules (exclusion/semantic_backup.py, semantic_original.py) for removal-or-port decision in Phase 1.
Treated bimodal/logos as read-only reference pattern; the parent-documented logos+bimodal-only fallback is last resort, not pre-emptive.
